name: GoliathGroundStation
tagline: Launch-ops ground station on GoliathApp: singleton gateway, OPC fan-out, operator identity.
description: GoliathGroundStation specializes GoliathApp for integration, pre-launch, and in-flight monitoring. A singleton ground gateway ingests umbilical or over-the-air telemetry and publishes OPC UA variables to N LabVIEW or other monitor stations. Live ingest is publish/subscribe, not workflow workers. GoliathApp supplies RBAC; Phase 3 requires DomainPrograms for sensor/actuator event logging and batch campaigns. Runtime services today live in a private ground-station codebase that is migrating into this public product; this repository owns the catalog surface and conversion plan.

features.title: Singleton rocket gateway
features.description: One trusted ingest path for umbilical poll and over-the-air events; decode once and publish OPC UA.

features.title: OPC fan-out to N monitors
features.description: Monitor station count scales with engines and vehicle variables. Stations subscribe; they do not wait for leased tasks.

features.title: Platform identity without task queues
features.description: GoliathApp RBAC authorizes operators and which tag trees a station may see.

features.title: DomainPrograms (Phase 3)
features.description: Required sensor/actuator event logging plus export, fixture, and promote campaigns — dual activation on the platform tier; live telemetry stays outside the worker claim loop.
